about: A Ruby library for reading, writing and changing Excel files.

prs.title: True and false values are saved into cells
prs.broken: Adding true or false to a cell left it blank in the saved file, with no error.
prs.changed: They are now saved as real true/false cells, the same way Excel stores them.
prs.matters: Spreadsheets made from Ruby keep their yes/no data instead of losing it.
